Chapter 22

Troubleshooting Clusters集群排障

When a Kubernetes cluster experiences infrastructure-level failures, the impact can be catastrophic. Pods refuse to schedule, applications become unreachable, and entire nodes disappear from the cluster, potentially affecting hundreds of workloads simultaneously. Unlike application-specific issues that might affect a single service, problems with cluster components and nodes strike at the very foundation of your Kubernetes environment, making their swift diagnosis and resolution critical for maintaining system availability.

当 Kubernetes 集群遭遇基础设施层面的故障时，影响可能是灾难性的：Pod 拒绝被调度、应用变得不可访问、整个节点从集群中消失，可能同时影响数百个工作负载。与可能只影响单个服务的应用层问题不同，集群组件和节点的问题直接打击 Kubernetes 环境的根基，因此快速诊断和解决它们对维持系统可用性至关重要。

This chapter equips you with the skills to troubleshoot these infrastructure-level problems. You’ll learn to decode node conditions, investigate why nodes transition to NotReady states, resolve resource pressure situations, and trace Pod scheduling failures back to their root causes.

本章将为你提供排查这些基础设施层问题的技能。你将学会解读节点状况、调查节点为何进入 NotReady 状态、解决资源压力情况，以及把 Pod 调度失败追溯到其根因。

Coverage of Curriculum Objectives考试大纲覆盖

This chapter addresses the following curriculum objectives: Troubleshoot clusters and nodes; Troubleshoot cluster components.

本章覆盖以下考试大纲目标：排查集群与节点问题；排查集群组件问题。

Inspecting the Status of Cluster Nodes检查集群节点状态

There are many influencing factors that can render a Kubernetes cluster faulty on the component level. It’s a good idea to list the nodes available in the cluster to identify potential issues:

有许多影响因素会让 Kubernetes 集群在组件层面出现故障。列出集群中可用的节点以识别潜在问题，是个好主意：

— PDF p.309 —
$ kubectl get nodes
NAME                 STATUS   ROLES           AGE     VERSION
control-plane-node   Ready    control-plane   2m45s   v1.33.2
worker-node-1        Ready    <none>          2m36s   v1.33.2
worker-node-2        Ready    <none>          2m29s   v1.33.2
worker-node-3        Ready    <none>          2m22s   v1.33.2

The output will give you a lay of the land. You can easily identify the responsibility of each node from the ROLES column, the Kubernetes version used, and the current health status.

该输出会让你对全局有个了解。你可以从 ROLES 列、所使用的 Kubernetes 版本以及当前健康状态，轻松识别每个节点的职责。

There are a couple of things to look out for when identifying issues at a high level:

在高层识别问题时，有几点需要留意：

  • Is the health status for the node anything other than Ready?节点的健康状态是否不是 Ready？
  • Does the version of a node deviate from the version of other nodes?某个节点的版本是否与其他节点不一致？

In the following sections you can find individual sections on troubleshooting control plane nodes versus worker nodes.

在接下来的小节中，你会找到分别针对控制平面节点和工作节点排障的内容。

Inspecting the Status of Cluster Components检查集群组件状态

Among those components available on the control plane node are the following:

控制平面节点上的组件包括：

  • kube-apiserver: Exposes the Kubernetes API used by clients like kubectl for managing objects.kube-apiserver：暴露 Kubernetes API，供 kubectl 等客户端用于管理对象。
  • etcd: A key-value store for storing the cluster data.etcd：用于存储集群数据的键值存储。
  • kube-scheduler: Selects nodes for Pods that have been scheduled but not created.kube-scheduler：为已被调度但尚未创建的 Pod 选择节点。
  • core-dns: Serves as the cluster’s DNS server, automatically creating DNS records that allow Pods and Services to discover each other by name rather than IP addresses, while also handling external DNS resolution for workloads.core-dns：作为集群的 DNS 服务器，自动创建 DNS 记录，让 Pod 和 Service 能按名称而非 IP 地址相互发现，同时为工作负载处理外部 DNS 解析。
  • kube-controller-manager: Runs controller processes (e.g., the job controller responsible for Job object execution).kube-controller-manager：运行控制器进程（例如负责 Job 对象执行的 job 控制器）。
  • cloud-controller-manager (optional): Links cloud provider–specific APIs to the Kubernetes cluster. This controller is not available in on-premise cluster installations of Kubernetes.cloud-controller-manager（可选）：把云厂商特有的 API 链接到 Kubernetes 集群。该控制器在 Kubernetes 的本地部署集群中不可用。
— PDF p.310 —

In addition to the components running specifically on the control plane nodes, every node (control plane and worker nodes) can contain the following components:

除了专门运行在控制平面节点上的组件之外，每个节点（控制平面和工作节点）还可能包含以下组件：

  • kubelet: Ensures that all Pods are running, including their containers.kubelet：确保所有 Pod 及其容器都在运行。
  • kube-proxy (optional): Maintains the network rules on nodes to implement Services.kube-proxy（可选）：在节点上维护网络规则以实现 Service。
  • Container runtime: The software component responsible for running containers.容器运行时：负责运行容器的软件组件。

To discover those components and their status, list the Pods available in the namespace kube-system. Be aware that some components do not run in a Pod, e.g., the kubelet or the container runtime. Here, you can find the list of components:

要发现这些组件及其状态，列出 namespace kube-system 中的 Pod。请注意，有些组件并不运行在 Pod 中，例如 kubelet 或容器运行时。下面可以看到组件列表：

$ kubectl get pods -n kube-system
NAME                      READY   STATUS    RESTARTS      AGE
etcd                      1/1     Running   1 (11d ago)   29d
kube-apiserver            1/1     Running   1 (11d ago)   29d
kube-controller-manager   1/1     Running   1 (11d ago)   29d
kube-scheduler            1/1     Running   1 (11d ago)   29d
...

Any status that does not show Running should be inspected further. You can retrieve the logs for control plane component Pods in the same fashion you do for any other Pod, using the logs command. The following command downloads the logs for the kube-apiserver component:

任何不是 Running 的状态都应进一步检查。你可以像对待其他 Pod 一样，使用 logs 命令获取控制平面组件 Pod 的日志。下面的命令下载 kube-apiserver 组件的日志：

$ kubectl logs kube-apiserver -n kube-system

In managed Kubernetes environments (EKS, GKE, AKS), many of these control plane Pods won’t be visible, as they run on provider-managed infrastructure outside your view. You might only see add-on Pods like kube-proxy, CoreDNS, and CNI components. While the CKA exam uses self-managed clusters where all control plane Pods are visible and accessible, it’s important to understand this distinction for real-world scenarios where troubleshooting control plane issues in managed services requires different approaches and often involves the cloud provider’s support.

在托管 Kubernetes 环境（EKS、GKE、AKS）中，许多控制平面 Pod 不可见，因为它们运行在你视野之外的、由提供商管理的基础设施上。你可能只能看到 kube-proxy、CoreDNS 和 CNI 组件等附加 Pod。虽然 CKA 考试使用自管理集群，所有控制平面 Pod 都可见且可访问，但在真实场景中理解这一区别很重要——在托管服务中排查控制平面问题需要不同的方法，且往往需要云厂商的支持。

Troubleshooting Node Issues节点问题排障

Control plane nodes are the critical components for keeping a cluster operational. As described in “Managing a Highly Available Cluster” on page 40, a cluster can consist of more than one control plane node to ensure a high degree of uptime. Detecting that one of the control plane nodes is faulty should be treated with extreme urgency to avoid compromising high-availability characteristics. For more information on troubleshooting techniques and root-cause analysis, reference the Kubernetes documentation.

控制平面节点是维持集群运行的关键组件。如第 40 页“Managing a Highly Available Cluster”所述，一个集群可以由多个控制平面节点组成，以确保高度的正常运行时间。一旦发现某个控制平面节点故障，应极其紧急地处理，以免损害高可用性。有关排障技巧和根因分析的更多信息，请参考 Kubernetes 文档。

— PDF p.311 —

Rendering Cluster Information展示集群信息

To further diagnose issues on the control plane node, run the command kubectl cluster-info. As you can see in the following output, the command renders the addresses of the control plane and other cluster services:

要进一步诊断控制平面节点上的问题，运行命令 kubectl cluster-info。如下面的输出所示，该命令展示控制平面及其他集群服务的地址：

$ kubectl cluster-info
Kubernetes control plane is running at https://192.168.64.21:8443
CoreDNS is running at https://192.168.64.21:8443/api/v1/namespaces/kube-system/services/kube-dns:dns/proxy

To further debug and diagnose cluster problems, use kubectl cluster-info dump.

For a detailed view of the cluster logs, append the dump subcommand. Due to the pages and pages of log messages, I won’t render the output in this book. Parse through the message to see if you can find any errors:

要查看集群日志的详细视图，追加 dump 子命令。由于日志消息长达一页又一页，本书不展示其输出。请通读消息，看看能否发现任何错误：

$ kubectl cluster-info dump

Node Showing NotReady Status节点显示 NotReady 状态

Worker nodes are responsible for managing the workload. Make sure you have a sufficient number of worker nodes available to distribute the load. For a deeper discussion on how to join worker nodes to a cluster, see Chapter 4.

工作节点负责管理工作负载。请确保有足够数量的工作节点可用以分担负载。关于如何把工作节点加入集群的更深入讨论，请参阅第 4 章。

Any of the nodes available in a cluster can transition into an error state. It’s your job as a Kubernetes administrator to identify those situations and fix them in a timely manner. When listing the nodes of a cluster, you may see that a worker node is not in the Ready state, which is a good indicator that it’s not available to handle the workload. In the output of the get nodes command, you can see that the node named worker-1 is in the NotReady state:

集群中任何可用节点都可能转入错误状态。作为 Kubernetes 管理员，你的职责是识别这些情况并及时修复。列出集群节点时，你可能看到某个工作节点不处于 Ready 状态，这是它无法处理工作负载的一个明显信号。在 get nodes 命令的输出中，你可以看到名为 worker-1 的节点处于 NotReady 状态：

$ kubectl get nodes
NAME            STATUS     ROLES           AGE     VERSION
control-plane   Ready      control-plane   4d20h   v1.33.2
worker-1        NotReady   <none>          4d20h   v1.33.2
worker-2        Ready      <none>          4d20h   v1.33.2

The NotReady state means that the node is unused and will accumulate operational costs without actually scheduling workload. There might be a variety of reasons why the node entered this state. The following list shows the most common reasons:

NotReady 状态意味着该节点未被使用，却会在不实际调度工作负载的情况下持续产生运维成本。节点进入该状态可能有多种原因。下面列出最常见的原因：

  • Insufficient resources: The node may be low on memory or disk space.资源不足：节点可能内存或磁盘空间告急。
— PDF p.312 —
  • Issues with the kubelet process: The process may have crashed or stopped on the node. Therefore, it cannot communicate with the API server running on any of the control plane nodes anymore.kubelet 进程问题：该进程可能在节点上崩溃或停止了，因此无法再与运行在任一控制平面节点上的 API server 通信。
  • Issues with kube-proxy: The Pod running kube-proxy is responsible for network communication from within the cluster and from the outside. The Pod transitioned into a nonfunctional state.kube-proxy 问题：运行 kube-proxy 的 Pod 负责集群内部和外部的网络通信；该 Pod 转入了不可用状态。

SSH into the relevant worker node(s) and start your investigation.

SSH 登录到相关工作节点，开始调查。

Checking Available Resources检查可用资源

A good way to identify the root cause of an unavailable worker node is to look at its details. The describe node command renders the section labeled Conditions:

识别不可用工作节点根因的一个好方法是查看其详情。describe node 命令会展示标记为 Conditions 的区段：

$ kubectl describe node worker-1
....
Conditions:
  Type                 Status  LastHeartbeatTime               LastTransitionTime                Reason                       Message
  ----                 ------  -----------------               ------------------                ------                       -------
  NetworkUnavailable   False   Thu, 20 Jan 2022 18:12:13 +0000 Thu, 20 Jan 2022 18:12:13 +0000   CalicoIsUp                   Calico is running on this node
  MemoryPressure       False   Tue, 25 Jan 2022 15:59:18 +0000 Thu, 20 Jan 2022 18:11:47 +0000   KubeletHasSufficientMemory    kubelet has sufficient memory available
  DiskPressure         False   Tue, 25 Jan 2022 15:59:18 +0000 Thu, 20 Jan 2022 18:11:47 +0000   KubeletHasNoDiskPressure      kubelet has no disk pressure
  PIDPressure          False   Tue, 25 Jan 2022 15:59:18 +0000 Thu, 20 Jan 2022 18:11:47 +0000   KubeletHasSufficientPID       kubelet has sufficient PID available
  Ready                True    Tue, 25 Jan 2022 15:59:18 +0000 Thu, 20 Jan 2022 18:12:07 +0000   KubeletReady                  kubelet is posting ready status. AppArmor enabled
...

The table contains information about the resources available to the node, as well as an indication of other services like networking. See if any of the resource types render the status True or Unknown, which means that there’s an issue with the particular resource. You can further troubleshoot unavailable resources with a system-level command.

该表格包含节点可用资源的信息，以及对网络等其他服务的指示。看看是否有任何资源类型显示 True 或 Unknown 状态，那意味着该特定资源存在问题。你可以用系统级命令进一步排查不可用资源。

— PDF p.313 —

To check on memory and the number of processes running, use the top command:

要检查内存和运行中的进程数，使用 top 命令：

$ top
top - 18:45:09 up 1 day,  2:21,  1 user,  load average: 0.13, 0.13, 0.15
Tasks: 116 total,   3 running,  70 sleeping,   0 stopped,   0 zombie
%Cpu(s):  1.5 us,  0.8 sy,  0.0 ni, 97.7 id,  0.0 wa,  0.0 hi,  0.0 si,  0.0 st
KiB Mem :  1008552 total,   134660 free,   264604 used,   609288 buff/cache
KiB Swap:        0 total,        0 free,        0 used.   611248 avail Mem
...

To check on the available disk space, use the command df:

要检查可用磁盘空间，使用 df 命令：

$ df -h
Filesystem      Size  Used Avail Use% Mounted on
udev            480M     0  480M   0% /dev
tmpfs            99M  1.0M   98M   2% /run
/dev/sda1        39G  2.7G   37G   7% /
tmpfs           493M     0  493M   0% /dev/shm
tmpfs           5.0M     0  5.0M   0% /run/lock
tmpfs           493M     0  493M   0% /sys/fs/cgroup
vagrant         1.9T  252G  1.6T  14% /vagrant
tmpfs            99M     0   99M   0% /run/user/1000

Checking the kubelet Process检查 kubelet 进程

Some conditions rendered by the describe node command mention the kubelet process. If you look at the Message column, you might get an idea if the kubelet process is running properly. To troubleshoot a misbehaving kubelet process, run the following systemctl command:

describe node 命令展示的某些状况会提到 kubelet 进程。如果你查看 Message 列，可能会了解 kubelet 进程是否正常运行。要对异常的 kubelet 进程排障，运行以下 systemctl 命令：

$ systemctl status kubelet
● kubelet.service - kubelet: The Kubernetes Node Agent
   Loaded: loaded (/lib/systemd/system/kubelet.service; enabled; vendor preset: enabled)
  Drop-In: /etc/systemd/system/kubelet.service.d
           └─10-kubeadm.conf
   Active: active (running) since Thu 2022-01-20 18:11:41 UTC; 5 days ago
     Docs: https://kubernetes.io/docs/home/
 Main PID: 6537 (kubelet)
    Tasks: 15 (limit: 1151)
   CGroup: /system.slice/kubelet.service
           └─6537 /usr/bin/kubelet --bootstrap-kubeconfig=/etc/kubernetes/bootstrap-kubelet.conf --kubeconfig=/etc/kubernetes/kubelet.conf --config=/var/lib/kubelet/config.yaml --network-lines 1-10/10

The most important information in the output is the value of the Active attribute. If it says something other than active (running), then you will need to dig deeper. Use journalctl to take a look at the log files of the process:

输出中最重要的信息是 Active 属性的值。如果它显示的不是 active (running)，你就需要深入排查。使用 journalctl 查看该进程的日志文件：

$ journalctl -u kubelet.service
-- Logs begin at Thu 2022-01-20 18:10:41 UTC, end at
— PDF p.314 —
Tue 2022-01-25 18:44:05 UTC. --
Jan 20 18:11:31 worker-1 systemd[1]: Started kubelet: The Kubernetes Node Agent.
Jan 20 18:11:31 worker-1 systemd[1]: kubelet.service: Current command vanished from the unit file, execution of the command list won't be resumed.
Jan 20 18:11:31 worker-1 systemd[1]: Stopping kubelet: The Kubernetes Node Agent...
Jan 20 18:11:31 worker-1 systemd[1]: Stopped kubelet: The Kubernetes Node Agent.
Jan 20 18:11:31 worker-1 systemd[1]: Started kubelet: The Kubernetes Node Agent.
....

You will want to restart the process once you have identified the issue in the logs and fixed it:

一旦在日志中识别出问题并修复后，你会想重启该进程：

$ systemctl restart kubelet

Checking Certificate Validity检查证书有效期

Sometimes, the certificate used by the kubelet can expire. Make sure that the values for the attributes Issuer and Not After are correct:

有时候 kubelet 使用的证书可能过期。请确认 Issuer 和 Not After 属性的值是否正确：

$ openssl x509 -in /var/lib/kubelet/pki/kubelet.crt -text
Certificate:
    Data:
        Version: 3 (0x2)
        Serial Number: 2 (0x2)
        Signature Algorithm: sha256WithRSAEncryption
        Issuer: CN = worker-1-ca@1642702301
        Validity
            Not Before: Jan 20 17:11:41 2022 GMT
            Not After : Jan 20 17:11:41 2023 GMT
        Subject: CN = worker-1@1642702301
        ...

For a quick rundown of all certificates in the cluster’s Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), you can use the following command:

要快速浏览集群公钥基础设施（PKI）中的所有证书，可以使用以下命令：

$ kubeadm certs check-expiration
[check-expiration] Reading configuration from the cluster...
[check-expiration] FYI: You can look at this config file with 'kubectl -n kube-system get cm kubeadm-config -o yaml'

CERTIFICATE                EXPIRES                  RESIDUAL TIME   ...
admin.conf                 Aug 31, 2026 14:28 UTC   364d            ...
apiserver                  Aug 31, 2026 14:28 UTC   364d            ...
apiserver-etcd-client      Aug 31, 2026 14:28 UTC   364d            ...
apiserver-kubelet-client   Aug 31, 2026 14:28 UTC   364d            ...
controller-manager.conf    Aug 31, 2026 14:28 UTC   364d            ...
etcd-healthcheck-client    Aug 31, 2026 14:28 UTC   364d            ...
etcd-peer                  Aug 31, 2026 14:28 UTC   364d            ...
etcd-server                Aug 31, 2026 14:28 UTC   364d            ...
front-proxy-client         Aug 31, 2026 14:28 UTC   364d            ...
scheduler.conf             Aug 31, 2026 14:28 UTC   364d            ...
super-admin.conf           Aug 31, 2026 14:28 UTC   364d            ...
— PDF p.315 —
CERTIFICATE AUTHORITY   EXPIRES                  RESIDUAL TIME   ...
ca                      Aug 29, 2035 14:28 UTC   9y              ...
etcd-ca                 Aug 29, 2035 14:28 UTC   9y              ...
front-proxy-ca          Aug 29, 2035 14:28 UTC   9y              ...

You can renew all certificates necessary to run the control plane with the following command:

你可以用以下命令续签运行控制平面所需的所有证书：

$ kubeadm certs renew all

You must restart the kube-apiserver, kube-controller-manager, kube-scheduler, and etcd, so that they can use the new certificates.

你必须重启 kube-apiserver、kube-controller-manager、kube-scheduler 和 etcd，使它们能够使用新证书。

Checking the kube-proxy Pod检查 kube-proxy Pod

The kube-proxy components run in a set of dedicated Pods in the namespace kube-system. You can clearly identify the Pods by their naming prefix kube-proxy and the appended hash. Verify if any of the Pods states a different status than Running. Each of the kube-proxy Pods runs on a dedicated worker node. You can add the -o wide option to render the node the Pod is running on in a new column:

kube-proxy 组件运行在 namespace kube-system 中的一组专用 Pod 里。你可以通过命名前缀 kube-proxy 及其后追加的哈希清楚地识别这些 Pod。请核实是否有任何 Pod 显示非 Running 的状态。每个 kube-proxy Pod 都运行在一个专用工作节点上。你可以加 -o wide 选项，在新列中展示该 Pod 所运行的节点：

$ kubectl get pods -n kube-system
NAME               READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
...
kube-proxy-csrww   1/1     Running   0          4d22h
kube-proxy-fjd48   1/1     Running   0          4d22h
kube-proxy-tvf52   1/1     Running   0          4d22h

Take a look at the event log for kube-proxy Pods that seem to have an issue. The following command describes the Pod named kube-proxy-csrww. In addition, you might find more information in the event log of the corresponding DaemonSet:

查看那些似乎有问题的 kube-proxy Pod 的事件日志。下面的命令 describe 名为 kube-proxy-csrww 的 Pod。此外，你还可以在对应 DaemonSet 的事件日志中找到更多信息：

$ kubectl describe pod kube-proxy-csrww -n kube-system
$ kubectl describe daemonset kube-proxy -n kube-system

The logs may come in handy as well. You will be able to check the logs for the kube-proxy Pod that runs on the specific worker node:

日志也可能派上用场。你将能够检查运行在特定工作节点上的那个 kube-proxy Pod 的日志：

$ kubectl describe pod kube-proxy-csrww -n kube-system | grep Node:
Node:                 worker-1/10.0.2.15
$ kubectl logs kube-proxy-csrww -n kube-system

Summary本章小结

Troubleshooting Kubernetes clusters and nodes requires a deep understanding of component interactions, systematic investigation skills, and familiarity with various debugging tools. The scenarios covered in this chapter represent common real-world issues you’ll encounter when managing Kubernetes infrastructure. By mastering these troubleshooting techniques, you’ll be able to quickly diagnose and resolve cluster-level problems, minimizing downtime and maintaining service reliability.

排查 Kubernetes 集群和节点需要深入理解组件交互、系统化的调查技能，以及对各种调试工具的熟悉。本章覆盖的场景代表了你在管理 Kubernetes 基础设施时会遇到的常见真实问题。掌握这些排障技巧后，你将能够快速诊断并解决集群级问题，最小化停机时间并维持服务可靠性。

— PDF p.316 —

Exam Essentials考试要点

  • Master quick node diagnostics and recovery. In the exam, you must rapidly identify why nodes are NotReady and fix them within minutes. Memorize this sequence: kubectl get nodes, kubectl describe node <node-name>, check the Conditions section for specific issues (MemoryPressure, DiskPressure, PIDPressure, Ready). Know how to SSH into nodes and use systemctl status kubelet, systemctl restart kubelet, and journalctl -u kubelet | tail -50 to diagnose and fix kubelet issues.掌握快速的节点诊断与恢复。考试中你必须在几分钟内快速识别节点为何 NotReady 并修复。记住这一顺序：kubectl get nodes、kubectl describe node <node-name>、在 Conditions 区段检查具体问题（MemoryPressure、DiskPressure、PIDPressure、Ready）。了解如何 SSH 登录节点，并使用 systemctl status kubelet、systemctl restart kubelet、journalctl -u kubelet | tail -50 来诊断和修复 kubelet 问题。
  • Know system Pod locations and recovery commands. You must instantly recognize and fix control plane component failures. Remember that static Pods (API server, controller-manager, scheduler, etcd) have their manifests in the directory /etc/kubernetes/manifests and their logs accessible via kubectl logs <component>-<node-name> -n kube-system. For crashed components, know that editing the manifest file directly will trigger the kubelet to restart the Pod automatically.了解系统 Pod 的位置与恢复命令。你必须立即识别并修复控制平面组件故障。请记住静态 Pod（API server、controller-manager、scheduler、etcd）的 manifest 位于目录 /etc/kubernetes/manifests，其日志可通过 kubectl logs <component>-<node-name> -n kube-system 访问。对于崩溃的组件，请知道直接编辑 manifest 文件会触发 kubelet 自动重启该 Pod。
  • Fix Pod scheduling issues. Understand how node issues prevent Pod scheduling and know the quick fixes. When Pods are Pending, check for node taints (kubectl describe node | grep Taint), verify node capacity (kubectl describe node | grep -A5 "Allocated resources"), and look for cordoned nodes (kubectl get nodes | grep SchedulingDisabled). Master these recovery commands: kubectl uncordon <node> to enable scheduling, kubectl taint nodes <node> <taint-key>- to remove taints (note the minus sign), and kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data for node maintenance.修复 Pod 调度问题。理解节点问题如何阻止 Pod 调度，并掌握快速修复方法。当 Pod 处于 Pending 时，检查节点污点（kubectl describe node | grep Taint）、核实节点容量（kubectl describe node | grep -A5 "Allocated resources"），并查找被隔离的节点（kubectl get nodes | grep SchedulingDisabled）。掌握这些恢复命令：kubectl uncordon <node> 以启用调度；kubectl taint nodes <node> <taint-key>- 以移除污点（注意减号）；kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data 用于节点维护。

Sample Exercises样题练习

Solutions to these exercises are available in Appendix A.

这些练习的解答见附录 A。

  1. Your team reports that applications are not scaling properly. Upon investigation, you notice one of the worker nodes is having issues and new Pods are not being scheduled there. This exercise assumes that you run a cluster with three nodes: one control plane node and two worker nodes. The names of the worker nodes are worker-node-1 and worker-node-2.你的团队报告应用未能正常扩缩容。调查后，你注意到其中一个工作节点出了问题，新 Pod 没有被调度到那里。本练习假设你运行一个三节点集群：一个控制平面节点和两个工作节点。工作节点名为 worker-node-1 和 worker-node-2。

  1. Navigate to the directory app-a/ch22/troubleshooting-worker-node of the checked-out GitHub repository bmuschko/cka-study-guide. Transfer the file setup.sh to the worker-node-2. SSH into the host machine of the worker-node-2 node. Execute the script. For proper execution of the script, make sure that you have kubectl installed on worker-node-2 beforehand and can authenticate with the API server of the control plane node. Identify why worker-node-2 is not accepting new Pods. Fix all issues preventing the node from functioning properly. Ensure the node can accept new Pod scheduling. Verify the fix by running a test Pod on that specific node.进入已 checkout 的 GitHub 仓库 bmuschko/cka-study-guide 中的目录 app-a/ch22/troubleshooting-worker-node。把文件 setup.sh 传到 worker-node-2。SSH 登录到 worker-node-2 节点的主机。执行该脚本。为使脚本正常执行，请事先确保 worker-node-2 上已安装 kubectl，并且能与控制平面节点的 API server 认证。找出 worker-node-2 为何不接受新 Pod。修复所有阻止该节点正常工作的问题。确保该节点能接受新 Pod 调度。通过在该特定节点上运行一个测试 Pod 来验证修复。
  2. The cluster is experiencing issues with Pod scheduling. New deployments are creating ReplicaSets, but Pods remain in Pending state despite having sufficient resources on nodes. This exercise assumes that you run a cluster with at least one control plane node and one worker node. The name of the control plane node is control-plane. Navigate to the directory app-a/ch22/troubleshooting-control-plane-node of the checked-out GitHub repository bmuschko/cka-study-guide. Transfer the file setup.sh to the control-plane node. SSH into the host machine of control-plane. Execute the script. Create a Deployment named test-app with the container image nginx:1.29.1 with three replicas. Identify which cluster component is failing on the control-plane node. Diagnose the root cause of the failure. Fix the component to restore proper cluster operation. Verify that Pod scheduling is working again.集群在 Pod 调度方面出现问题。新的 Deployment 正在创建 ReplicaSet，但尽管节点上资源充足，Pod 仍处于 Pending 状态。本练习假设你运行一个至少有一个控制平面节点和一个工作节点的集群。控制平面节点名为 control-plane。进入已 checkout 的 GitHub 仓库 bmuschko/cka-study-guide 中的目录 app-a/ch22/troubleshooting-control-plane-node。把文件 setup.sh 传到 control-plane 节点。SSH 登录到 control-plane 的主机。执行该脚本。创建名为 test-app 的 Deployment，容器镜像 nginx:1.29.1，三个副本。找出 control-plane 节点上是哪个集群组件在故障。诊断故障的根因。修复该组件以恢复集群正常运行。验证 Pod 调度已恢复正常。
